summary: Improve audit scheduling, evidence control, reporting and follow-up. Explore this practical five-day audit administration course.
lede: Audit administration helps internal audit coordinators, administrators and executive support staff coordinate engagements and maintain reliable records. Learners practise building schedules, logging evidence, controlling workpapers and report versions, tracking corrective actions, and preparing committee papers and status updates using Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate internal audit engagements, maintain audit records or provide executive and committee support. It suits intermediate-level roles with working exposure to audit operations and administrative workflows.
audience: Executive Assistants to Chief Audit Executives
prerequisites: Prior exposure to internal audit administration, audit records, evidence requests or executive support is recommended. No coding is required.
